name: Photera
tagline: Grow more lettuce. Blame fewer spreadsheets.
positioning: Photera is the operations layer for indoor farms — one control plane for climate, yield, and the 40 sensors nobody wants to babysit.

hero.h1: The farm runs itself. You take the credit.
hero.sub: Photera unifies climate control, nutrient dosing, and yield forecasting across every rack, room, and facility — so your growers stop firefighting and start scaling.

features.title: One control plane, every rack
features.description: Pipe HVAC, lighting, irrigation, and dosing pumps into a single dashboard. No more toggling between four vendor apps and a whiteboard.

features.title: Yield forecasts that hold up
features.description: Predict harvest weight per tray 18 days out, then watch us flag the drift before your quarterly numbers do.

features.title: Alerts worth waking up for
features.description: We suppress the noise and only ping you when a chiller actually dies — not when a sensor sneezes at 3am.

features.title: Recipe version control
features.description: Fork, test, and roll back grow recipes like code. Every basil batch traces back to the exact light and nutrient curve that made it.

features.title: Multi-site, one truth
features.description: Compare kilos-per-kWh across facilities in different time zones without exporting a single CSV.

features.title: Audit-ready by default
features.description: GAP, food-safety, and energy logs generate themselves. Hand the binder to the auditor and go home.

testimonials.quote: We were running three farms on a group chat and vibes. Photera cut our crop-loss rate by a third in one quarter and I finally sleep through the night.
testimonials.name: Marisol Idánez

testimonials.quote: The yield forecasts are annoyingly accurate. My CFO now trusts a dashboard more than she trusts me, which is fine, I guess.
testimonials.name: Devon Ashcroft

testimonials.quote: Onboarding took nine days across two facilities. The last platform quoted us nine months and a consultant named Chad.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
